purpose: Freeze data access, parameter selection, payload accounting, and outcome reporting before the revised codec and alarm experiments run.

global_rules.unit_of_analysis: monitoring record; paths are features within a record and are never resampled as independent observations
global_rules.historical_exploration: Existing E2/E4/PCA outputs are exploratory only and cannot be used to select a reported operating point.

codec_benchmark.system_boundary: Post-compensation waveform coding. The benchmark measures payload for residual records reconstructed by software. It does not measure ADC acquisition power, MCU execution time, or hardware energy.

quantization.scale_fit: maximum absolute residual value over healthy training residuals only
quantization.saturation_reporting: report the fraction of samples clipped in every split and condition

payload_accounting.per_record: serialize actual codec packets and report bytes per 66-path record and bits per original sample
payload_accounting.hard_capacity_contract: At every target, every serialized healthy and damaged record packet must be no larger than the target. SoD reserves an equal per-path packet cap including its timestamp/level framing and stops only at an event boundary; a decoder then holds the final transmitted level.
payload_accounting.model_side_information: report decoder model bytes separately; do not amortize them into the per-record payload
payload_accounting.raw_reference: the fixed 16-bit residual representation; this is a storage contract, not an assertion about the source ADC

codec_benchmark.operating_point_selection: For each codec and target, retain only predeclared candidates with a proven worst-case packet bound no greater than the target. Fixed-configuration uniform, PCA, and Haar candidates use the closest proven bound. Bounded-SoD uses healthy-validation mean payload closest to the target; payload ties use lower code-domain reconstruction MSE on 8 chronologically evenly spaced healthy-validation records, then frozen candidate order. No labels or test records are used.

paired_temperature_analysis.matching: one-to-one Hungarian assignment using absolute temperature difference only

metrics: test ROC AUC with record-level stratified bootstrap confidence interval
mean, median, 95th-percentile, and maximum serialized payload

cold_start_alarm.system_boundary: Software replay of an OBS+BSS plus event-count alarm. It is not a hardware deployment claim.

reference_bank.selection: chronologically evenly spaced records within each temperature bin

level_a_event_count.delta_fit: per-path 95th percentile of absolute March residual samples at deterministic stride 16

cold_start_alarm.alarm_calibration: robust per-path normalization and all threshold-grid values fitted on 2021_03 only
primary_metrics: false calls per day on the healthy 2021_04 prefix
first post-onset delay of a newly started alarm incident; a pre-onset active incident is reported but is not credited as detection
post-onset record and day exceedance coverage
fraction of target records outside the calibration temperature support
cold_start_alarm.prohibited_term: Do not label the one observed onset as a statistically estimated probability of detection.
